login.title: Masjid Admin
login.lead: Assalamu Alaikum. Log in with your phone’s screen lock.
login.screenLockHint: Your phone will ask for your screen lock (PIN, pattern, face or fingerprint).
login.trouble: Having trouble? Contact the Masjid Connect team
login.failed: Login didn’t work. Please try again.
login.cancelled: Login was cancelled. Tap “Log in” to try again.
login.noScreenLock: Your phone needs a screen lock to log in. Set one in your phone’s settings, then try again.
login.sessionEnded: You were logged out. Please log in again.

undertaking.agree: I have read and I agree

timings.title: Prayer Times
timings.needAll: Set all five jamaat times so your masjid can go live.

timings.quotaBody: You can still save. Followers will see the new times when they open the app.
timings.savedQuiet: Followers will see the new times.

notice.rightsHint: Photos of people only with their permission.

posts.removedHint: Posts that break the content policy are removed. Followers no longer see them.

posts.savedBody: Followers see the change in the app, marked “edited”.

profile.hijriHint: Adjust it if the moon was seen a day earlier or later here.

voice.voiceTitleHint: One line: what the voice note is about.

payment.scanFilled: UPI ID filled from the QR. Check the name.
payment.scanUnavailable: The camera cannot be used here. Type the UPI ID instead.

payment.sent: Sent. The Super Admin will check it.
payment.waiting: A change is waiting. You can ask again once it is decided.
